verdict.rationale: Gusto can be driven without its UI through a documented Embedded/App Integrations API and an official agent-friendly CLI, with a separate demo environment for testing. However, API access is restricted to integration and Embedded Payroll partners, and nothing documents CI pipelines, non-interactive authentication, or headless job execution. Missing for 10: documented CI/headless usage patterns, non-interactive or service-account auth for the CLI, general (non-partner) API availability, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The Gusto Embedded API behavior is built on core fundamentals that apply to every endpoint.
